title: THC Professional Cultivation SOP and Quality Systems Certificate
publicDescription: Demonstrates applied capability in controlled SOP execution, deviation handling, data integrity, document control, audit evidence, acceptance criteria, and quality-system escalation.
limitations: This Academy credential is educational and employment-oriented; it is not a government cannabis license or occupational license.
It does not confer quality-manager, compliance-officer, legal, or regulatory authority beyond assigned workplace responsibility.
